_comment: THE ONE HAND-MAINTAINED INPUT TO THE ADMIN COMPLETION LEDGER.
the route list from the file tree, navigation and scope from the registry,
endpoints from a live trace of every API route, composition from a source
scan. What cannot be derived is whether somebody actually opened the page
in a browser and saw something correct. That is what this file records.
Every proof value names an ARTEFACT — a test file, a screenshot, a run —
not an adjective. `"desktop": "verified"` is not evidence; a filename is.
The generator rejects a completed status that is missing any required
proof, so a row cannot claim more than it can show.
Status starts at PENDING and stays there until the proofs exist. That is
the honest default and the reason the ledger is worth reading.
